criteria.outcome: 7: Be able to understand the use of defensive driving techniques to reduce risk while driving
criteria.criterion:
Demonstrate defensive driving techniques including:
• Driver attitude and behaviour
• Safe acceleration
• Safe use of brakes
• Safe use of signals before manoeuvring
• Proper visual scanning techniques including blind spot monitoring
• Maintaining safe distance and continually creating space
• Hazard awareness
• Consideration and co-operation with other road users
• Maintaining safe vehicle control
• Correct driving techniques and considerations for all environments

criteria.outcome: 7: Be able to understand the use of defensive driving techniques to reduce risk while driving
criteria.criterion:
Conduct a continuous commentary drive for a minimum of 5 minutes.
Commentary should cover:
• Mirrors
• Signals
• Position
• Speed
• Hazard identification
